name: Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea
summary: Near Auberdine's watch, Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea directs the defense of Darkshore. The seasoned night elf sentry sends travelers to meet threats and investigate strange signs along the coast.

sections.title: Guardian of Auberdine
sections.body: From Auberdine, Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea coordinates scouts as corruption grows and hostile forces press into Darkshore. She watches the wilderness around town and relies on capable travelers to guard the perimeter and protect night elf holdings along the coast.

sections.title: Threats Along the Coast
sections.body: Glynda watches for dangers gathering along the shore, especially the bolder murlocs south of town. She oversees bounties on threats such as Murkdeep and sends scouts to examine strange finds, including a crimson crystal reported near Darkshore's eastern mountain range.

faq.answer: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea is a night elf stationed in Auberdine, where she organizes scout patrols and defenses across Darkshore.

faq.q: Where can Glynda Nal'Shea be found?
faq.answer: Glynda Nal'Shea can be found in Auberdine, Darkshore's main Alliance settlement, near the sentinel watch and town entrances.

faq.q: What quests does Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea offer?
faq.answer: Glynda offers work against regional dangers, including a bounty on Murkdeep and an investigation of the red crystal along Darkshore's cliffs.

faq.q: Why is Glynda concerned about Murkdeep?
faq.answer: Murkdeep is a vicious murloc chieftain whose attacks on night elf outposts and travelers threaten the southern coast and Auberdine's security.

faq.q: What is the Red Crystal quest line?
faq.answer: The Red Crystal investigation begins with Glynda sending scouts up Darkshore's eastern cliffs to examine a strange, pulsing crystal and retrieve fragments for study.

faq.q: What faction does Glynda Nal'Shea serve?
faq.answer: Glynda Nal'Shea serves the night elves of Darnassus and commands an Alliance military outpost in Darkshore.

angles.text: For night elves, Glynda Nal'Shea reflects the vigilance needed to protect Kalimdor's sacred shores from aggressive beasts and ancient corruption.
As a hunter, you may recognize Glynda's sharp instincts and direct approach to dealing with wild beasts and shoreline predators.
As an Alliance traveler arriving by boat from Teldrassil or the Eastern Kingdoms, you can take Glynda's bounties to help secure Darkshore's perimeter.
